sourceRefs.locator: 5.48.1–3: Jovius meets Alaric at Ariminum and sends demands including annual gold, grain and settlement to the emperor

summary.de: Römischer Unterhändler. Er traf Alarich in Ariminum und leitete dessen Forderungen an Honorius weiter.
summary.en: Roman negotiator. He met Alaric at Ariminum and forwarded his demands to Honorius.
